{{Quote|General, they've been hit.|Nastia Unamo|<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>}}
'''Nastia Unamo''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served the [[First Order]] as a [[Chief Petty Officer|chief petty officer]] on board the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Finalizer]]'',<ref name="DB Unamo" /> the [[flagship]] of [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]] and [[General]] [[Armitage Hux]],<ref name="DB Finalizer">{{Databank|finalizer|''Finalizer''}}</ref> during the [[Cold War]] [[New Republic Era|era]].<ref name="Episode VII" /> She supervised the massive [[Star Destroyer]]'s crew and reported to higher-[[Military rank|ranking]] [[First Order officer|members]] of the command crew such as [[Lieutenant]] [[Dopheld Mitaka]].<ref name="DB Unamo" />

Unamo wore a [[Color|black]] [[Clothing|lighter fabric duty uniform]] with spotless regulation [[boot]]s and [[Comlink|intercomm]] headset. Unamo had light skin, black [[hair]], and blue [[eye]]s.<ref name="TFAVD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nastia Unamo first appeared in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. She was portrayed by [[Kate Fleetwood]], who was credited only as "First Order Officer,"<ref name="Episode VII" /> with the character's name first being revealed as Unamo in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="TFAVD" /> The character was then given the first name Nastia by author [[Adam Bray]]<ref name="Bray1">{{Twitter|authoradambray|status/1315448719152754688|[[Adam Bray]]|date=2020-10-12|quote=Starting with First Order Chief Petty Officer Nastia Unamo, played by the magnificent @katefleetwood. I had the honor of retconning her with a first name, Nastia. Unamo reminds me of the many strong Russian expatriates I knew in Vietnam. Nastia is my favorite Russian lady's name.|archivedate=20210428153706}}</ref> in the [[2019]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''.<ref name="USWN">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> The name Unamo reminded Bray of Russian expatriates that he had known while in Vietnam, and so he chose his favorite Russian woman's name, Nastia,<ref name="Bray1" /> enjoying the fact that it also appropriately sounded like the word "nasty."<ref name="Bray2">{{Twitter|authoradambray|status/1315449760950747138|[[Adam Bray]]|date=2020-10-12|quote=Nastia is a beautiful Russian name, like the actress, but the name always gave me a little chuckle too because it sounds like "nasty." I thought it a fitting name for an officer of the villainous First Order who was hunting Rey and BB-8 in The Force Awakens.|archivedate=20210428153733}}</ref>
